---
description: "Use for Copilot coding work in this repository. Explain proposed changes for the user to review and learn before editing."
name: "Propose Before Editing"
applyTo: "**"
---

# Propose Before Editing

- For coding, cleanup, refactoring, and bug-fix requests, first inspect the relevant code and explain the proposed changes before editing.
- Walk the user through which files would change, what each change does, why it is useful, and any behavior changes or tradeoffs.
- Wait for the user's explicit approval before modifying files. A broad request to investigate or clean something up is not approval to edit.
- After approval, make only the approved changes, then report what changed and how it was verified.
